To help everyone taking part in IPO Prime put their capital to work more efficiently and get more out of the promotion, Bitget is launching the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit. Once the Anthropic IPO allocation is settled, your unallocated funds are automatically moved into the exclusive Simple Earn Flexible product for the asset you committed, earning a boosted APR of up to 10% for 15 days (see the table below for exact rates). Interest is paid out every hour, and you can redeem at any time.
1. Promotion details

During the promotion period, users who subscribe to IPO Prime with a supported asset and keep the "IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit' enabled will, after allocation settlement, have their unallocated funds moved first into the IPO Prime exclusive Simple Earn Flexible product and earn the exclusive 15-day APR.The benefit applies to both the VIP round and the public round, with exclusive quota available on a first-come, first-served basis:
IPO Prime exclusive Simple Earn
Exclusive APR
Exclusive APR period
Supported subscription asset
Exclusive Simple Earn Flexible
15 days
*The exclusive product exists only to hold unallocated IPO Prime funds. It cannot be subscribed to directly from the Earn page or through the API.
*If the exclusive product's quota is insufficient, funds are moved into another Simple Earn Flexible product you're currently eligible to subscribe to and earn interest at the applicable tiered rate.
*Unallocated funds from the VIP round and the public round both go into the exclusive product for the same asset and share that asset's exclusive APR.
*Product parameters are subject to what's displayed on the product page.Once the exclusive APR period ends, the product rate is adjusted in real time based on market conditions.
2. How to enable or disable "IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit"
Set it when you subscribe:
Website: IPO Prime > Anthropic > Subscribe > check the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit at the bottom of the subscription pop-up.
App: Home > IPO Prime entry > Anthropic > Subscribe > check the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit at the bottom of the subscription pop-up.
Exact entry names and locations are subject to what's displayed on the actual product page.
3. Exclusive quota queueing and modification rules

1. Queueing rules: exclusive quota is allocated in order of the first subscription time corresponding to each queued amount, with the VIP round and the public round calculating allocations and unallocated funds separately.Unallocated funds from the VIP round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the VIP round, and unallocated funds from the public round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the public round.A single user's unallocated funds from the VIP round and the public round each form one separate queue entry. If the same asset is subscribed to more than once within a round, the unallocated funds for that round are combined into a single entry.

2. Modifying after subscribing: the subscription pop-ups for both the VIP round and the public round let you enable/disable this feature, and you can change the setting up until the public round's subscription end time. This setting applies to all your unallocated funds in both the VIP round and the public round. Changing the setting during the public round also changes how your VIP round unallocated funds are handled. Enabling, disabling, or enabling it back does not change your position in the exclusive quota queue. Queueing is always based on your first subscription time in each round.The system applies the last setting you confirmed before the deadline.
4. How to view your details after allocation settlement

Allocation results: IPO Prime > Anthropic > View allocation results.VIP round and public round results are shown separately, so you can check your subscription quantity, committed amount, allocated amount, unallocated funds, and whether the exclusive Earn benefit is enabled for each asset.
Earn holdings (website): Navigation bar > Earn > Account overview > Simple Earn Flexible.
Earn holdings (app): Home > Earn overview > Simple Earn > Holdings details.

4. Interest calculation: hourly interest = accrual amount × that hour's APR ÷ 365 ÷ 24.

1. Promotion details

*The exclusive product exists only to hold unallocated IPO Prime funds. It cannot be subscribed to directly from the Earn page or through the API.
*If the exclusive product's quota is insufficient, funds are moved into another Simple Earn Flexible product you're currently eligible to subscribe to and earn interest at the applicable tiered rate.
*Unallocated funds from the VIP round and the public round both go into the exclusive product for the same asset and share that asset's exclusive APR.
*Product parameters are subject to what's displayed on the product page.Once the exclusive APR period ends, the product rate is adjusted in real time based on market conditions.
2. How to enable or disable "IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit"
Set it when you subscribe:
Website: IPO Prime > Anthropic > Subscribe > check the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit at the bottom of the subscription pop-up.
App: Home > IPO Prime entry > Anthropic > Subscribe > check the IPO Prime exclusive Earn benefit at the bottom of the subscription pop-up.
Exact entry names and locations are subject to what's displayed on the actual product page.
3. Exclusive quota queueing and modification rules

1. Queueing rules: exclusive quota is allocated in order of the first subscription time corresponding to each queued amount, with the VIP round and the public round calculating allocations and unallocated funds separately.Unallocated funds from the VIP round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the VIP round, and unallocated funds from the public round are ranked by each user's first subscription time in the public round.A single user's unallocated funds from the VIP round and the public round each form one separate queue entry. If the same asset is subscribed to more than once within a round, the unallocated funds for that round are combined into a single entry.

2. Modifying after subscribing: the subscription pop-ups for both the VIP round and the public round let you enable/disable this feature, and you can change the setting up until the public round's subscription end time. This setting applies to all your unallocated funds in both the VIP round and the public round. Changing the setting during the public round also changes how your VIP round unallocated funds are handled. Enabling, disabling, or enabling it back does not change your position in the exclusive quota queue. Queueing is always based on your first subscription time in each round.The system applies the last setting you confirmed before the deadline.
4. How to view your details after allocation settlement

Allocation results: IPO Prime > Anthropic > View allocation results.VIP round and public round results are shown separately, so you can check your subscription quantity, committed amount, allocated amount, unallocated funds, and whether the exclusive Earn benefit is enabled for each asset.
Earn holdings (website): Navigation bar > Earn > Account overview > Simple Earn Flexible.
Earn holdings (app): Home > Earn overview > Simple Earn > Holdings details.
